```tsx presets/twitter/demo.tsx
function formatCount(n: number): string {
  if (n >= 1000) return `${(n / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '')}K`;
  return String(n);
}

const actionClass =
  'flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-neutral-100 hover:text-neutral-900 dark:hover:bg-neutral-800 dark:hover:text-neutral-100';

/** Reply / repost / like / share row. Reply opens the viewer (thread beside it). */
function ActionBar({
  stats,
  onReply,
}: {
  stats: ThreadPost['stats'];
  onReply: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="-mb-1.5 -ms-2 mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-neutral-500">
      <button type="button" className={actionClass} aria-label="View replies" onClick={onReply}>
        <MessageCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden />
        <span>{formatCount(stats?.replies ?? 0)}</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" className={actionClass} aria-label="Repost">
        <Repeat2 className="size-4" aria-hidden />
        <span>{formatCount(stats?.reposts ?? 0)}</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" className={actionClass} aria-label="Like">
        <Heart className="size-4" aria-hidden />
        <span>{formatCount(stats?.likes ?? 0)}</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" className={actionClass} aria-label="Share">
        <Share className="size-4" aria-hidden />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Per-cell rounded corners for the 1–4 cell grids. Inner edges stay sharp;
 * outer corners match the parent grid. The radius must live on the Trigger —
 * the morph reads it to animate corner rounding.
 */
function cornerClass(index: number, count: number): string {
  if (count === 2) {
    return index === 0 ? 'rounded-l-xl' : 'rounded-r-xl';
  }
  if (count === 3) {
    if (index === 0) return 'rounded-l-xl';
    return index === 1 ? 'rounded-tr-xl' : 'rounded-br-xl';
  }
  if (count === 4) {
    return ['rounded-tl-xl', 'rounded-tr-xl', 'rounded-bl-xl', 'rounded-br-xl'][index]!;
  }
  return 'rounded-xl';
}

/**
 * Facebook-style trigger grid: 1 image fills the width, 2–4 tile into a
 * grid, and 5+ collapse the extras behind a `+N` overlay tile. Every tile is
 * a `Lightbox.Trigger`, so tapping one morphs into the viewer at that index.
 */
function ImageGrid({ imgs }: { imgs: LightboxItem[] }) {
  const count = imgs.length;

  if (count === 1) {
    const only = imgs[0]!;
    return (
      <Lightbox.Trigger index={0} className="block w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-transparent p-0">
        {({ imageRef }) => (
          <img
            ref={imageRef}
            src={only.thumb}
            alt={only.alt}
            width={only.width}
            height={only.height}
            className="block w-full object-cover"
            draggable={false}
          />
        )}
      </Lightbox.Trigger>
    );
  }

  if (count === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-0.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl">
        {imgs.map((img, i) => (
          <Lightbox.Trigger
            key={img.src}
            index={i}
            className={`block overflow-hidden bg-transparent p-0 ${cornerClass(i, 2)}`}
          >
            {({ imageRef }) => (
              <img
                ref={imageRef}
                src={img.thumb}
                alt={img.alt}
                width={img.width}
                height={img.height}
                className="block aspect-4/5 w-full object-cover"
                draggable={false}
              />
            )}
          </Lightbox.Trigger>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (count === 3) {
    const first = imgs[0]!;
    return (
      <div className="grid aspect-3/2 grid-cols-2 grid-rows-2 gap-0.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl">
        <Lightbox.Trigger
          index={0}
          className={`row-span-2 block overflow-hidden bg-transparent p-0 ${cornerClass(0, 3)}`}
        >
          {({ imageRef }) => (
            <img
              ref={imageRef}
              src={first.thumb}
              alt={first.alt}
              width={first.width}
              height={first.height}
              className="block size-full object-cover"
              draggable={false}
            />
          )}
        </Lightbox.Trigger>
        {imgs.slice(1, 3).map((img, idx) => {
          const i = idx + 1;
          return (
            <Lightbox.Trigger
              key={img.src}
              index={i}
              className={`block overflow-hidden bg-transparent p-0 ${cornerClass(i, 3)}`}
            >
              {({ imageRef }) => (
                <img
                  ref={imageRef}
                  src={img.thumb}
                  alt={img.alt}
                  width={img.width}
                  height={img.height}
                  className="block size-full object-cover"
                  draggable={false}
                />
              )}
            </Lightbox.Trigger>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const extra = count - 4;
  return (
    <div className="grid aspect-3/2 grid-cols-2 grid-rows-2 gap-0.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl">
      {imgs.slice(0, 4).map((img, i) => {
        const showOverlay = i === 3 && extra > 0;
        return (
          <Lightbox.Trigger
            key={img.src}
            index={i}
            crossfade={showOverlay ? 'both' : undefined}
            className={`block overflow-hidden bg-transparent p-0 ${cornerClass(i, 4)}`}
          >
            {({ imageRef }) => (
              // The whole tile crossfades (overlay included), but the
              // destination placeholder is sourced from `imageRef` only — so
              // the "+N" overlay never bleeds into the viewer image.
              <span className={`relative block size-full overflow-hidden ${cornerClass(i, 4)}`}>
                <img
                  ref={imageRef}
                  src={img.thumb}
                  alt={img.alt}
                  width={img.width}
                  height={img.height}
                  className="block size-full object-cover"
                  draggable={false}
                />
                {showOverlay && (
                  <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50">
                    <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">+{extra}</span>
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
            )}
          </Lightbox.Trigger>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One feed post wired to the split viewer. */
function FeedPostGallery({ post }: { post: FeedPost }) {
  const { author } = post.thread;
  const stats = post.thread.stats;
  // Imperative handle so the reply action (not a Trigger) can open the viewer.
  const [handle] = React.useState(() => RamkaLightbox.createHandle());

  return (
    <Lightbox.Root
      handle={handle}
      loop
      // Extras hidden behind the `+N` tile have no trigger of their own —
      // close to the nearest visible one instead of flashing.
      morphTo={post.images.length > 4 ? 'closest' : undefined}
      // Thumbs are the same photos at lower res (same file + aspect), so the
      // placeholder bridge is seamless — skip the decode wait and start the
      // morph immediately.
      awaitImageDecode={false}
    >
      <article className="flex gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-start">
        <img src={author.avatar} alt="" className="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover" draggable={false} />
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-1 text-sm">
            <span className="font-bold text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-50">{author.name}</span>
            <span className="text-neutral-500">@{author.handle}</span>
            <span className="text-neutral-500">· {post.time}</span>
          </div>

          <p className="mb-3 mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap text-[15px] leading-snug text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-100">
            {post.thread.text}
          </p>

          <ImageGrid imgs={post.images} />

          <ActionBar stats={stats} onReply={() => handle.open(0)} />
        </div>
      </article>

      <Lightbox.Gallery
        items={post.images}
        thread={post.thread}
        ariaLabel={`Photos by ${author.name}`}
      />
    </Lightbox.Root>
  );
}

export function TwitterPresetDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl divide-y divide-neutral-200 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-neutral-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:divide-neutral-800 dark:border-neutral-700 dark:bg-neutral-900">
      {feed.map((post) => (
        <FeedPostGallery key={post.id} post={post} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Store

A full commerce viewer: the media stage (vertical thumbnail rail, pager, corner zoom) sits beside a buy panel with price, highlights, and the add-to-cart CTA — on mobile the panel collapses into a sticky price + CTA bar, so the shopper never loses the buy button while inspecting photos. Copy the **Package** files ( `lightbox.tsx` + `lightbox.css`) into your design system, then wire triggers in your app. The **Example** tab shows a product card whose thumbnails swap the main image, viewer navigation synced back so the close morph lands on the visible image, and add-to-cart state shared between the card and the viewer.

## Source

```tsx presets/store/lightbox.tsx
'use client';

/**
 * Store lightbox — design-system package entry (copy with lightbox.css).
 *
 * A full commerce viewer, not just a photo overlay: the media stage keeps a
 * vertical thumbnail rail (desktop) with a bottom ‹ 2 / 5 › pagination
 * cluster and corner zoom controls, while a buy panel stays alongside —
 * product name, price (with compare-at), description, highlights, stock note
 * and the add-to-cart CTA. Mobile swaps the panel for a sticky price + CTA
 * bar under the media. The shopper never loses the buy button while
 * inspecting photos.
 */

import * as React from 'react';
import * as RamkaLightbox from '@ramka/react/lightbox';

import './lightbox.css';

function cx(...parts: Array<string | false | null | undefined>) {
  return parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}

/* ── Icons (inline — no icon library dependency) ─────────────────────────── */

function IconX() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden>
      <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function IconChevronLeft() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden>
      <path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function IconChevronRight() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden>
      <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function IconZoomIn() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden>
      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" />
      <path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3M11 8v6M8 11h6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function IconZoomOut() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden>
      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" />
      <path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3M8 11h6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ── Public types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/** Item shape for `Lightbox.Gallery` — pass real intrinsic pixel size. */
export type LightboxItem = {
  id?: string | number;
  src: string;
  thumb: string;
  alt: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
};

/** Product data rendered by the buy panel (desktop) and mobile bar. */
export type ProductInfo = {
  name: string;
  price: string;
  /** Original price, rendered struck-through next to `price`. */
  compareAtPrice?: string;
  /** Short label above the name, e.g. “New colour” or “Bestseller”. */
  badge?: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Bullet points under the description. */
  highlights?: string[];
  /** Availability line above the CTA, e.g. “In stock — ships in 2 days”. */
  stockNote?: string;
};

/* ── Styled primitives (design-system re-exports) ───────────────────────── */

function Root(props: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Root>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Root {...props} />;
}

function Trigger({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Trigger>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Trigger className={cx('slb-trigger', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Portal({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Portal>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Portal className={cx('slb-portal', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Backdrop({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Backdrop>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Backdrop className={cx('slb-backdrop', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Content({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Content>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Content className={cx('slb-content', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Stage({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Stage>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Stage className={cx('slb-stage', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Close({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Close>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Close className={cx('slb-control', 'slb-close', className)} aria-label="Close" {...props}>
      {children ?? <IconX />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Close>
  );
}

function Slides({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Slides>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Slides className={cx('slb-slides', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Slide({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Slide>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Slide className={cx('slb-slide', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Item(props: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Item>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Item {...props} />;
}

function Media({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Media>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Media className={cx('slb-media', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Zoom(props: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Zoom>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Zoom {...props} />;
}

function ZoomIn({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.ZoomIn>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.ZoomIn className={cx('slb-control', className)} aria-label="Zoom in" {...props}>
      {children ?? <IconZoomIn />}
    </RamkaLightbox.ZoomIn>
  );
}

function ZoomOut({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.ZoomOut>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.ZoomOut className={cx('slb-control', className)} aria-label="Zoom out" {...props}>
      {children ?? <IconZoomOut />}
    </RamkaLightbox.ZoomOut>
  );
}

function Counter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Counter>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Counter className={cx('slb-counter', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Previous({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Previous>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Previous
      className={cx('slb-control', 'slb-nav', className)}
      aria-label="Previous"
      {...props}
    >
      {children ?? <IconChevronLeft />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Previous>
  );
}

function Next({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Next>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Next
      className={cx('slb-control', 'slb-nav', className)}
      aria-label="Next"
      {...props}
    >
      {children ?? <IconChevronRight />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Next>
  );
}

function Thumbnail(props: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Thumbnail>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Thumbnail {...props} />;
}

function ThumbnailGroup(props: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.ThumbnailGroup>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.ThumbnailGroup {...props} />;
}

/* ── Buy panel pieces ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function PriceRow({ product, compact }: { product: ProductInfo; compact?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span className={compact ? 'slb-mobile-price' : 'slb-price-row'}>
      <span className="slb-price">{product.price}</span>
      {product.compareAtPrice ? <s className="slb-compare-at">{product.compareAtPrice}</s> : null}
    </span>
  );
}

/* ── Composed Gallery (commerce viewer) ─────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Store commerce viewer — Portal → Backdrop + Content → Stage (slides,
 * vertical thumbnail rail, ‹ 2 / 5 › cluster, corner zoom, close) beside a
 * buy panel (desktop) / above a sticky price + CTA bar (mobile).
 *
 * The rail is a plain `ThumbnailGroup` tablist (not the scroll-linked
 * ThumbnailStrip): PDP galleries have a handful of images, so all thumbs are
 * visible and arrow keys / clicks jump directly.
 *
 * Pass `panel` to replace the default panel body with your own composition
 * (variant pickers, size selectors, reviews) — the package chrome stays.
 */
function Gallery({
  items,
  product,
  ariaLabel,
  ctaLabel = 'Add to bag',
  onAddToCart,
  panel,
}: {
  items: LightboxItem[];
  product: ProductInfo;
  ariaLabel: string;
  ctaLabel?: string;
  onAddToCart?: () => void;
  panel?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const multiple = items.length > 1;

  return (
    <Portal>
      <Backdrop />
      <Content aria-label={ariaLabel}>
        <Stage>
          <Slides
            aria-label="Product images"
            // The library ships no copy, so the words announcing the carousel
            // and its slides live here, next to the rest of your UI strings.
            aria-roledescription="carousel"
            preload={2}
          >
            {items.map((item, i) => (
              <Slide key={item.id ?? i}>
                <Item
                  index={i}
                  aria-roledescription="slide"
                  // With the rail the item is a `tabpanel` its thumbnail tab
                  // already names, so only the single-image shape needs a name.
                  {...(multiple ? {} : { 'aria-label': `${i + 1} of ${items.length}` })}
                >
                  <Zoom maxZoom={5}>
                    <Media width={item.width} height={item.height}>
                      <img
                        width={item.width}
                        height={item.height}
                        src={item.src}
                        alt={item.alt}
                        loading="eager"
                        draggable={false}
                      />
                    </Media>
                  </Zoom>
                </Item>
              </Slide>
            ))}
          </Slides>

          <Close className="slb-chrome-gesture-hide" />

          {multiple ? (
            <ThumbnailGroup className={cx('slb-rail', 'slb-chrome-gesture-hide')} aria-label="Product images">
              {items.map((item, i) => (
                <Thumbnail key={item.id ?? i} index={i} className="slb-rail-thumb">
                  <img src={item.thumb} alt={item.alt} draggable={false} />
                </Thumbnail>
              ))}
            </ThumbnailGroup>
          ) : null}

          {multiple ? (
            <div className={cx('slb-pager', 'slb-chrome-gesture-hide')}>
              <Previous />
              <Counter>{({ current, total }) => `${current} / ${total}`}</Counter>
              <Next />
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <div className={cx('slb-zoom-group', 'slb-chrome-gesture-hide')}>
            <ZoomOut />
            <ZoomIn />
          </div>
        </Stage>

        {/* The buy context (panel / mobile bar) stays put during pull-to-dismiss —
            only the stage chrome fades. */}
        <aside className="slb-panel" aria-label="Product details">
          {panel ?? (
            <>
              <div className="slb-panel-body">
                {product.badge ? <span className="slb-badge">{product.badge}</span> : null}
                <h2 className="slb-name">{product.name}</h2>
                <PriceRow product={product} />
                {product.description ? <p className="slb-description">{product.description}</p> : null}
                {product.highlights?.length ? (
                  <ul className="slb-highlights">
                    {product.highlights.map((line) => (
                      <li key={line}>{line}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                ) : null}
              </div>
              <div className="slb-panel-footer">
                {product.stockNote ? <p className="slb-stock">{product.stockNote}</p> : null}
                <button type="button" className="slb-cta" onClick={onAddToCart}>
                  {ctaLabel}
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </aside>

        {/* Mobile: the buy context rides along under the media. */}
        <div className="slb-mobile-bar">
          <div className="slb-mobile-info">
            <span className="slb-mobile-name">{product.name}</span>
            <PriceRow product={product} compact />
          </div>
          <button type="button" className={cx('slb-cta', 'slb-cta-compact')} onClick={onAddToCart}>
            {ctaLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      </Content>
    </Portal>
  );
}

/**
 * Styled Lightbox namespace — drop-in replacement for `import * as Lightbox from '@ramka/react/lightbox'`
 * with this preset’s styles and composed Gallery.
 */
export const Lightbox = {
  Root,
  Trigger,
  Portal,
  Backdrop,
  Content,
  Stage,
  Close,
  Slides,
  Slide,
  Item,
  Media,
  Zoom,
  ZoomIn,
  ZoomOut,
  Counter,
  Previous,
  Next,
  Thumbnail,
  ThumbnailGroup,
  Gallery,
};
```

```css presets/store/lightbox.css
/**
 * Store lightbox skin — pairs with lightbox.tsx (copy both files).
 *
 * Commerce viewer: a soft-neutral media stage (vertical thumbnail rail,
 * ‹ 2 / 5 › pager, corner zoom) beside a white buy panel; on mobile the panel
 * collapses into a sticky price + CTA bar. Class prefix: `slb-`. Dark mode:
 * `.dark` or `[data-theme='dark']` on an ancestor (e.g. <html>).
 *
 * Variables named `--lightbox-*` are written by the library at runtime
 * (gesture progress, motion timing) — this file only reads them. All
 * view-transition CSS (morph group, snapshots, crossfade) is injected by the
 * library; skins ship none of it.
 */

.slb-portal {
  --slb-ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  /* Narrower panel until the viewport can spare the room. */
  --slb-panel-width: 20rem;
  --slb-mobile-bar-height: 4.25rem;
}

@media (min-width: 1280px) {
  .slb-portal {
    --slb-panel-width: 24rem;
  }
}

/* ── Trigger ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.slb-trigger {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  appearance: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.slb-trigger:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.slb-trigger:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ── Backdrop / Content open-close + pull ───────────────────────────────── */

.slb-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  background-color: #fff;
  /* `--lightbox-pull-snap-*` exist only while a cancelled pull springs back;
     otherwise the Root's `viewTransition` preset clock. */
  transition: opacity var(--lightbox-pull-snap-duration, var(--lightbox-vt-duration, 360ms))
    var(--lightbox-pull-snap-easing, var(--slb-ease-out));
}

:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .slb-backdrop {
  background-color: #000;
}

@starting-style {
  .slb-backdrop[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* `--lightbox-pull-progress` is 0 → 1 while pull-to-dismiss drags. */
.slb-backdrop[data-open] {
  opacity: calc(1 - var(--lightbox-pull-progress, 0) * 0.6);
}

.slb-backdrop[data-pulling] {
  transition: none; /* follow the finger */
}

.slb-content {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  outline: none;
  opacity: 0;
  color: #171717;
  transition: opacity var(--lightbox-vt-duration, 360ms) var(--slb-ease-out);
}

:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .slb-content {
  color: #fafafa;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .slb-content {
    flex-direction: row;
  }
}

.slb-content[data-open] {
  opacity: 1;
}

@starting-style {
  .slb-content[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* ── Stage (media pane) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.slb-stage {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1 1 0%;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  /* Soft-neutral plane behind the product shots. The alpha tracks the pull
     gesture so dragging to dismiss reveals the page — the backdrop alone
     can't do it when the stage paints its own surface. */
  background-color: rgb(245 245 245 / calc(1 - var(--lightbox-pull-progress, 0)));

  /* Letterbox insets around the media (Slide padding). Mobile: full-bleed
     images (no inline inset); the buy bar is in flow BELOW the stage, so the
     bottom inset only clears the counter — zoomed media pans inside the
     stage and can never slide under the bar. */
  --slb-inset-top: calc(3.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
  --slb-inset-bottom: 3.25rem;
  --slb-inset-inline: 0px;
}

/* Dark: black canvas, gray sidebar — the product plane goes fully dark while
   the buy panel lifts off it. */
:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .slb-stage {
  background-color: rgb(0 0 0 / calc(1 - var(--lightbox-pull-progress, 0)));
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .slb-stage {
    --slb-inset-top: 4rem;
    /* Clears the ‹ 2 / 5 › pager and the corner zoom group. */
    --slb-inset-bottom: 5.5rem;
    --slb-inset-inline: 2rem;
  }
}

/* The thumbnail rail only exists from lg up — below that the panel already
   eats most of the width, so the media keeps a slim letterbox instead. */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .slb-stage {
    /* Clears the rail (left) and keeps the letterbox symmetric. */
    --slb-inset-inline: 6.5rem;
  }
}

.slb-slides {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  gap: 1rem;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.slb-slides::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.slb-slide {
  flex: 0 0 100%;
  min-width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: var(--slb-inset-top) var(--slb-inset-inline) var(--slb-inset-bottom);
}

.slb-media img {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

/* ── Chrome hide during gestures ────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* `visibility` (not just opacity) keeps hidden controls out of the tab
   order; its 0s flip is delayed to the end of the fade-out. */
.slb-chrome-gesture-hide {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transition:
    opacity 200ms,
    visibility 0s linear 0s;
}

@starting-style {
  .slb-chrome-gesture-hide {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* Pull hides everything; zoom clears the navigation chrome so the media can
   pan freely (zoom group + close stay for the way back out). */
.slb-content:is([data-pulling], [data-pull-dismissing]) .slb-chrome-gesture-hide,
.slb-content[data-zoomed] :is(.slb-rail, .slb-pager) {
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition:
    opacity 200ms,
    visibility 0s linear 200ms;
}

/* ── Controls (flat white circles, readable over photos) ────────────────── */

.slb-control {
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 2.25rem;
  width: 2.25rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08);
  background-color: #fff;
  color: #171717;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06);
  transition:
    background-color 150ms ease-out,
    border-color 150ms ease-out,
    transform 150ms ease-out,
    opacity 150ms ease-out;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.slb-control:hover {
  background-color: #f5f5f5;
}

.slb-control:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

.slb-control:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.slb-control:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.slb-control:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.3;
}

.slb-control:disabled:active {
  transform: none;
}

.slb-control svg {
  display: block;
  width: 1.125rem;
  height: 1.125rem;
}

:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .slb-control {
  border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14);
  background-color: #262626;
  color: #fafafa;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4);
}

:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .slb-control:hover {
  background-color: #333;
}

.slb-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(0.875rem + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
  inset-inline-end: 0.875rem;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* ── Thumbnail rail (desktop) ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

.slb-rail {
  display: none;
}

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .slb-rail {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-start: 1.25rem;
    top: 50%;
    z-index: 1;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    max-height: calc(100% - 7rem);
    overflow-y: auto;

    /* Breathing room so the active thumb's offset ring isn't clipped. */

  }

    display: none;
  }
}

/* Square, hard-cornered tiles — matches the product card's thumbnail row. */

  box-sizing: border-box;

  flex-shrink: 0;

  margin: 0;

}

  outline: none;

  outline: none;
}

.slb-cta:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .slb-cta {
  background-color: #fafafa;
  color: #171717;
}

:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .slb-cta:hover {
  background-color: #e5e5e5;
}

/* ── Mobile buy bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* In flow below the stage (not an overlay): the stage — and with it the zoom
   pan area — ends above the bar, so zoomed media is never covered by it. */
.slb-mobile-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  min-height: var(--slb-mobile-bar-height);
  padding: 0.625rem 1rem calc(0.625rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  border-top: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06);
  background-color: #fff;
}

:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .slb-mobile-bar {
  border-top-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);
  background-color: #171717;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .slb-mobile-bar {
    display: none;
  }
}

.slb-mobile-info {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.125rem;
}

.slb-mobile-name {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.slb-mobile-price {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.375rem;
}

.slb-mobile-price .slb-price {
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
}

.slb-mobile-price .slb-compare-at {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

/* The bar's CTA hugs its label instead of filling the row. */
.slb-cta-compact {
  width: auto;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
}
```

```tsx presets/store/demo.tsx
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';

import { Lightbox, type LightboxItem, type ProductInfo } from './lightbox';

/**
 * App-level demo — not part of the copy-paste package.
 *
 * A product card: small thumbs swap the main image (plain app state, not
 * lightbox triggers), and the main image is the single `Lightbox.Trigger` for
 * whatever is selected. `onValueChange` syncs viewer navigation back into
 * that selection, so the close morph always lands on the image the user is
 * looking at. Add-to-cart state is shared between the card and the viewer's
 * buy panel via `ctaLabel` / `onAddToCart`.
 */

const product: ProductInfo = {
  name: 'Terra 27L Backpack',
  price: '$149',
  compareAtPrice: '$189',
  badge: 'New colour',
  description:
    'Waxed canvas, full-grain leather straps, and a padded 16″ laptop sleeve. Weather-ready for the daily commute or a weekend on the trail.',
  highlights: [
    'Water-resistant waxed canvas shell',
    'Padded 16″ laptop compartment',
    'Magnetic quick-access top pocket',
    'Lifetime repair guarantee',
  ],
  stockNote: 'In stock — ships in 2 days',
};

const images: LightboxItem[] = [
  {
    src: '/photos/store-pack-a.jpg',
    thumb: '/photos/store-pack-a-thumb.jpg',
    alt: 'Terra 27L backpack, front view',
    width: 1200,
    height: 1500,
  },
  {
    src: '/photos/store-pack-b.jpg',
    thumb: '/photos/store-pack-b-thumb.jpg',
    alt: 'Terra 27L backpack, side profile',
    width: 1200,
    height: 1500,
  },
  {
    src: '/photos/store-pack-c.jpg',
    thumb: '/photos/store-pack-c-thumb.jpg',
    alt: 'Detail of the waxed canvas and zippers',
    width: 1200,
    height: 1200,
  },
  {
    src: '/photos/store-pack-d.jpg',
    thumb: '/photos/store-pack-d-thumb.jpg',
    alt: 'The backpack on a trail at golden hour',
    width: 1600,
    height: 1000,
  },
  {
    src: '/photos/store-pack-e.jpg',
    thumb: '/photos/store-pack-e-thumb.jpg',
    alt: 'Interior compartments, laptop sleeve visible',
    width: 1200,
    height: 1500,
  },
];

export function StorePresetDemo() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState(0);
  const [added, setAdded] = React.useState(false);
  const current = images[selected]!;

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-2xl">
      <Lightbox.Root
        loop
        onValueChange={(value) => setSelected(value)}
        // Thumbs are the same product shots at lower res (same file + aspect),
        // so the placeholder bridge is seamless — skip the decode wait and
        // start the morph immediately.
        awaitImageDecode={false}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 md:flex-row md:items-start md:gap-8">
          {/* Gallery column */}
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <Lightbox.Trigger
              index={selected}
              className="block w-full overflow-hidden bg-neutral-100 p-0 dark:bg-neutral-800"
            >
              {({ imageRef }) => (
                <img
                  ref={imageRef}
                  key={current.src}
                  src={current.thumb}
                  alt={current.alt}
                  width={current.width}
                  height={current.height}
                  className="block aspect-square w-full object-cover"
                  draggable={false}
                />
              )}
            </Lightbox.Trigger>

            <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2" role="listbox" aria-label="Select product image">
              {images.map((img, i) => (
                <button
                  key={img.src}
                  type="button"
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected={i === selected}
                  aria-label={img.alt}
                  onClick={() => setSelected(i)}
                  className={`block size-14 shrink-0 overflow-hidden border p-0 transition ${
                    i === selected
                      ? 'border-neutral-900 dark:border-neutral-100'
                      : 'border-neutral-200 opacity-70 hover:opacity-100 dark:border-neutral-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  <img src={img.thumb} alt="" className="block size-full object-cover" draggable={false} />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Info column */}
          <div className="w-full md:w-56 md:shrink-0">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
              {product.badge}
            </p>
            <h3 className="mt-1.5 text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-50">
              {product.name}
            </h3>
            <p className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-2 text-[15px]">
              <span className="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-100">{product.price}</span>
              <s className="text-[13px] text-neutral-400">{product.compareAtPrice}</s>
            </p>
            <p className="mt-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400">{product.description}</p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setAdded(true)}
              className="mt-6 w-full rounded-full bg-neutral-900 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-white transition hover:bg-neutral-700 dark:bg-neutral-100 dark:text-neutral-900 dark:hover:bg-neutral-300"
            >
              {added ? 'Added to bag ✓' : 'Add to bag'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Lightbox.Gallery
          items={images}
          product={product}
          ariaLabel={`${product.name} gallery`}
          ctaLabel={added ? 'Added to bag ✓' : 'Add to bag'}
          onAddToCart={() => setAdded(true)}
        />
      </Lightbox.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Editorial

The viewer newsrooms use for article figures: a near-black surface in both color schemes, a typography-forward caption and credit block under the media, and ghost controls. Keyboard-first, no zoom — a reading context, not an inspection one. Copy the **Package** files ( `lightbox.tsx` + `lightbox.css`) into your design system, then wire triggers in your app. The **Example** tab shows an article excerpt whose inline figures open the viewer with their caption and credit.

## Source

```tsx presets/editorial/lightbox.tsx
'use client';

/**
 * Editorial lightbox — design-system package entry (copy with lightbox.css).
 *
 * The viewer newsrooms use for article figures: a near-black surface in both
 * color schemes (photography reads best on dark), a typography-forward
 * caption + credit block under the media, a counter top-left, and ghost
 * controls. Keyboard-first; no zoom — this is a reading context, not an
 * inspection one (swipe / arrows to browse, pull down to dismiss).
 */

import * as React from 'react';
import * as RamkaLightbox from '@ramka/react/lightbox';

import './lightbox.css';

function cx(...parts: Array<string | false | null | undefined>) {
  return parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}

/* ── Icons (inline — no icon library dependency) ─────────────────────────── */

function IconX() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden>
      <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function IconChevronLeft() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden>
      <path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function IconChevronRight() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden>
      <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ── Public types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/** Item shape for `Lightbox.Gallery` — pass real intrinsic pixel size. */
export type LightboxItem = {
  id?: string | number;
  src: string;
  thumb?: string;
  alt: string;
  /** The figure caption — a sentence describing the photograph. */
  caption?: string;
  /** The credit line, e.g. “Photograph: Anna Beck / Agence Lumière”. */
  credit?: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
};

/* ── Styled primitives (design-system re-exports) ───────────────────────── */

function Root(props: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Root>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Root {...props} />;
}

function Trigger({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Trigger>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Trigger className={cx('elb-trigger', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Portal({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Portal>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Portal className={cx('elb-portal', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Backdrop({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Backdrop>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Backdrop className={cx('elb-backdrop', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Content({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Content>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Content className={cx('elb-content', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Close({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Close>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Close className={cx('elb-control', className)} aria-label="Close" {...props}>
      {children ?? <IconX />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Close>
  );
}

function Slides({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Slides>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Slides className={cx('elb-slides', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Slide({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Slide>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Slide className={cx('elb-slide', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Item({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Item>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Item className={cx('elb-item', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Media({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Media>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Media className={cx('elb-media', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Counter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Counter>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Counter className={cx('elb-counter', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Caption({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Caption>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Caption className={cx('elb-caption', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Previous({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Previous>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Previous className={cx('elb-control', 'elb-nav', 'elb-nav-prev', className)} {...props}>
      {children ?? <IconChevronLeft />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Previous>
  );
}

function Next({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Next>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Next className={cx('elb-control', 'elb-nav', 'elb-nav-next', className)} {...props}>
      {children ?? <IconChevronRight />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Next>
  );
}

/* ── Composed Gallery (article figure viewer) ───────────────────────────── */

/** Caption + credit as one node for `Item.caption` → rendered by `Caption`. */
function figureCaption(item: LightboxItem): React.ReactNode {
  if (!item.caption && !item.credit) return undefined;
  return (
    <>
      {item.caption ? <span className="elb-caption-text">{item.caption}</span> : null}
      {item.credit ? <span className="elb-credit">{item.credit}</span> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * Editorial figure viewer — Portal → Backdrop + Content → Slides with a
 * caption + credit block beneath the media, counter top-left, close
 * top-right, and desktop edge navigation.
 */
function Gallery({ items, ariaLabel }: { items: LightboxItem[]; ariaLabel: string }) {
  const multiple = items.length > 1;

  return (
    <Portal>
      <Backdrop />
      <Content aria-label={ariaLabel}>
        <Slides
          aria-label="Article photographs"
          // The library ships no copy, so the words announcing the carousel and
          // its slides live here, next to the rest of your UI strings.
          aria-roledescription="carousel"
          preload={2}
        >
          {items.map((item, i) => (
            <Slide key={item.id ?? i}>
              <Item
                index={i}
                caption={figureCaption(item)}
                aria-roledescription="slide"
                aria-label={`${i + 1} of ${items.length}`}
              >
                <Media width={item.width} height={item.height}>
                  <img
                    width={item.width}
                    height={item.height}
                    src={item.src}
                    alt={item.alt}
                    loading="eager"
                    draggable={false}
                  />
                </Media>
              </Item>
            </Slide>
          ))}
        </Slides>

        <div className={cx('elb-top', 'elb-chrome-gesture-hide')}>
          {multiple ? <Counter>{({ current, total }) => `${current} / ${total}`}</Counter> : <span />}
          <Close />
        </div>

        {multiple ? (
          <>
            <Previous className="elb-chrome-gesture-hide" />
            <Next className="elb-chrome-gesture-hide" />
          </>
        ) : null}

        <div className={cx('elb-bottom', 'elb-chrome-gesture-hide')}>
          <Caption />
        </div>
      </Content>
    </Portal>
  );
}

/**
 * Styled Lightbox namespace — drop-in replacement for `import * as Lightbox from '@ramka/react/lightbox'`
 * with this preset’s styles and composed Gallery.
 */
export const Lightbox = {
  Root,
  Trigger,
  Portal,
  Backdrop,
  Content,
  Close,
  Slides,
  Slide,
  Item,
  Media,
  Counter,
  Caption,
  Previous,
  Next,
  Gallery,
};
```

```css presets/editorial/lightbox.css
/**
 * Editorial lightbox skin — pairs with lightbox.tsx (copy both files).
 *
 * Article figure viewer: near-black surface in BOTH color schemes (deliberate
 * — photography reads best on dark, like NYT / Guardian viewers), so there
 * are no dark-mode overrides in this file. Class prefix: `elb-`.
 *
 * Variables named `--lightbox-*` are written by the library at runtime
 * (gesture progress, motion timing) — this file only reads them. All
 * view-transition CSS (morph group, snapshots, crossfade) is injected by the
 * library; skins ship none of it.
 */

.elb-portal {
  --elb-ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

/* ── Trigger ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.elb-trigger {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  appearance: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.elb-trigger:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.elb-trigger:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ── Backdrop / Content open-close + pull ───────────────────────────────── */

.elb-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  background-color: #0a0a0a;
  /* `--lightbox-pull-snap-*` exist only while a cancelled pull springs back;
     otherwise the Root's `viewTransition` preset clock. */
  transition: opacity var(--lightbox-pull-snap-duration, var(--lightbox-vt-duration, 360ms))
    var(--lightbox-pull-snap-easing, var(--elb-ease-out));
}

@starting-style {
  .elb-backdrop[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* `--lightbox-pull-progress` is 0 → 1 while pull-to-dismiss drags. */
.elb-backdrop[data-open] {
  opacity: calc(1 - var(--lightbox-pull-progress, 0) * 0.6);
}

.elb-backdrop[data-pulling] {
  transition: none; /* follow the finger */
}

.elb-content {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  outline: none;
  opacity: 0;
  color: #fafafa;
  transition: opacity var(--lightbox-vt-duration, 360ms) var(--elb-ease-out);

  /* Letterbox insets around the media (Slide padding). The bottom band holds
     the caption + credit block. */
  --elb-inset-top: calc(3.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
  --elb-inset-bottom: calc(6rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  --elb-inset-inline: 1rem;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .elb-content {
    --elb-inset-top: calc(4rem + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
    --elb-inset-bottom: calc(6.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    /* Room for the edge chevrons. */
    --elb-inset-inline: 5rem;
  }
}

.elb-content[data-open] {
  opacity: 1;
}

@starting-style {
  .elb-content[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* ── Slides / Media ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.elb-slides {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  gap: 1rem;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.elb-slides::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.elb-slide {
  flex: 0 0 100%;
  min-width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: var(--elb-inset-top) var(--elb-inset-inline) var(--elb-inset-bottom);
}

/* This viewer has no zoom, so Item stands in for the `Lightbox.Zoom` wrapper
   structurally: Media's fit-box resolves `cqw`/`cqh` against the nearest size
   container, and the flex centering letterboxes it inside the slide insets. */
.elb-item {
  container-type: size;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.elb-media img {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

/* ── Chrome hide during gestures ────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* `visibility` (not just opacity) keeps hidden controls out of the tab
   order; its 0s flip is delayed to the end of the fade-out. */
.elb-chrome-gesture-hide {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transition:
    opacity 200ms,
    visibility 0s linear 0s;
}

@starting-style {
  .elb-chrome-gesture-hide {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

.elb-content:is([data-pulling], [data-pull-dismissing]) .elb-chrome-gesture-hide {
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition:
    opacity 200ms,
    visibility 0s linear 200ms;
}

/* ── Top band: counter + close ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

.elb-top {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: calc(0.875rem + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)) 1rem 0;
}

/* The counter reads "1 / 7": two digit runs around a neutral separator, with no
   strong-direction character to anchor them. An RTL base direction reorders
   that into "7 / 1", so pin the ratio to LTR and isolate it from neighbours. */
.elb-counter {
  direction: ltr;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
}

.elb-counter {
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55);
}

/* ── Caption + credit band ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.elb-bottom {
  /* Click-through the inset band; the caption opts back in for selection. */
  pointer-events: none;
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  padding-inline: 1.25rem;
  padding-bottom: calc(1.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
}

/* One column, reading width. `Item.caption` delivers the caption text and
   the credit line as separate spans (see lightbox.tsx). */
.elb-caption {
  pointer-events: auto;
  -webkit-user-select: text;
  user-select: text;
  display: flex;
  max-width: 42rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.375rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.elb-caption-text {
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.92);
}

.elb-credit {
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.45);
}

/* ── Controls (ghost circles) ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

.elb-control {
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 2.5rem;
  width: 2.5rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  border: 0;
  background-color: transparent;
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8);
  transition:
    background-color 150ms ease-out,
    color 150ms ease-out,
    opacity 150ms ease-out,
    transform 150ms ease-out;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.elb-control:hover {
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);
  color: #fff;
}

.elb-control:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

.elb-control:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.elb-control:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.elb-control:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.25;
}

.elb-control:disabled:active {
  transform: none;
}

.elb-control svg {
  display: block;
  width: 1.25rem;
  height: 1.25rem;
}

/* ── Edge navigation (desktop) ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

.elb-nav {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  z-index: 1;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 3rem;
  height: 3rem;
}

.elb-nav:active {
  transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.96);
}

.elb-nav:disabled:active {
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

/* Inline axis, not physical: the previous item is the one nearer index 0,
   which is the right-hand side under RTL. */
.elb-nav-prev {
  inset-inline-start: 1rem;
}

.elb-nav-next {
  inset-inline-end: 1rem;
}

/* A chevron is a directional glyph, so mirroring the button positions is only
   half of it — the icon has to point the other way too. Flip the icon rather
   than the button: the button already carries a translate. */
.elb-nav:dir(rtl) svg {
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

/* Edge chevrons are desktop-only; mobile swipes. */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .elb-nav {
    display: none;
  }
}
```

```tsx presets/editorial/demo.tsx
'use client';

import { Lightbox, type LightboxItem } from './lightbox';

/**
 * App-level demo — not part of the copy-paste package.
 *
 * An article excerpt with inline figures: each `<figure>` is a
 * `Lightbox.Trigger`, and opening one morphs into the editorial viewer with
 * that figure's caption + credit under the media.
 */

const figures: LightboxItem[] = [
  {
    src: '/photos/edit-harbor.jpg',
    thumb: '/photos/edit-harbor-thumb.jpg',
    alt: 'The old harbor at dawn, boats resting in still water',
    caption: 'The old harbor at dawn. Most of the fleet has not left the quay in a decade.',
    credit: 'Photograph: Anna Beck',
    width: 1600,
    height: 1000,
  },
  {
    src: '/photos/edit-nets.jpg',
    thumb: '/photos/edit-nets-thumb.jpg',
    alt: 'Fishing nets stacked on the pier',
    caption: 'Nets stacked on the pier — mended each winter, used less each spring.',
    credit: 'Photograph: Anna Beck',
    width: 1000,
    height: 1400,
  },
  {
    src: '/photos/edit-market.jpg',
    thumb: '/photos/edit-market-thumb.jpg',
    alt: 'The near-empty fish market hall in the early morning',
    caption: 'The market hall opens at five. By seven, the day’s catch is gone.',
    credit: 'Photograph: Jonas Ravn',
    width: 1600,
    height: 1000,
  },
];

function Figure({ index, className }: { index: number; className?: string }) {
  const item = figures[index]!;
  return (
    <figure className={className}>
      <Lightbox.Trigger index={index} className="block w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-transparent p-0 scroll-my-5">
        {({ imageRef }) => (
          <img
            ref={imageRef}
            src={item.thumb}
            alt={item.alt}
            width={item.width}
            height={item.height}
            className="block w-full object-cover"
            draggable={false}
          />
        )}
      </Lightbox.Trigger>
      <figcaption className="mt-2 text-[13px] leading-5 text-neutral-500">
        {item.caption} <span className="text-neutral-400 dark:text-neutral-600">{item.credit}</span>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  );
}

export function EditorialPresetDemo() {
  return (
    <article className="w-full max-w-xl text-start">
      <Lightbox.Root
        loop
        // Thumbs are the same photographs at lower res (same file + aspect),
        // so the placeholder bridge is seamless — skip the decode wait and
        // start the morph immediately.
        awaitImageDecode={false}
        // Figures are scattered through a scrolling article, so after swiping
        // to another photograph its trigger may be off-viewport. `onClose`
        // repositions it inside the close transition's update phase — between
        // snapshot captures — so the page jump is never painted as a live
        // frame. (Scrolling earlier, e.g. `onChange`, makes iOS Safari
        // re-rasterize the open viewer and flash black tiles over the media.)
        scrollTriggerIntoView={[
          { type: 'onOpenComplete', behavior: 'instant', block: 'nearest' },
          { type: 'onClose', behavior: 'instant', block: 'nearest' },
        ]}
      >
        <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-neutral-400">Dispatch</p>
        <h3 className="mt-2 font-serif text-[26px] leading-snug tracking-tight text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-50">
          The last fishermen of the northern coast
        </h3>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-neutral-500">By Anna Beck · 8 min read</p>

        <p className="mt-5 text-[15px] leading-7 text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300">
          The village wakes before the light does. For sixty years the boats went out whatever the weather; now, on most
          mornings, only three engines cough to life along the whole quay.
        </p>

        <Figure index={0} className="mt-6" />

        <p className="mt-6 text-[15px] leading-7 text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300">
          Ask anyone here when it changed and they will not name a year. The harbor emptied the way harbors do — one
          retirement at a time, one son who moved to the city, one quota that made a small boat pointless.
        </p>

        <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <Figure index={1} />
          <Figure index={2} />
        </div>

        <Lightbox.Gallery items={figures} ariaLabel="Article photographs" />
      </Lightbox.Root>
    </article>
  );
}
```

# Stories

Instagram-style stories: a horizontal row of avatars, each dissolving into a vertical video via `crossfade="both"` (the circle is not the 9:16 frame, so a geometry morph would look wrong). Inside the viewer, slides are a native snap scroller with a CSS view-timeline rotateY — cards hinge on their leading edge as they enter and on their trailing edge as they leave. Copy the **Package** files (`lightbox.tsx` + `lightbox.css`) into your design system, then wire triggers in your app.

## Source

```tsx presets/stories/lightbox.tsx
'use client';

/**
 * Stories lightbox — design-system package entry (copy with lightbox.css).
 *
 * Instagram-style vertical stories: circular avatar triggers dissolve into a
 * 9:16 card via `crossfade`, then swipe between stories with a CSS
 * scroll-driven rotateY (view-timeline) page-turn. No zoom — swipe / arrows
 * to browse, pull down to dismiss.
 */

import * as React from 'react';
import * as RamkaLightbox from '@ramka/react/lightbox';
import { useLightboxContext } from '@ramka/react';

import './lightbox.css';

function cx(...parts: Array<string | false | null | undefined>) {
  return parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}

/* ── Icons (inline — no icon library dependency) ─────────────────────────── */

function IconX() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden>
      <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function IconChevronLeft() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden>
      <path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function IconChevronRight() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden>
      <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ── Public types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/** Item shape for `Lightbox.Gallery` — pass real intrinsic pixel size. */
export type LightboxItem = {
  id?: string | number;
  name: string;
  avatar: string;
  video: string;
  poster: string;
  alt: string;
  /** Relative time shown in the story HUD, e.g. “2h”. */
  time?: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
};

/* ── Styled primitives (design-system re-exports) ───────────────────────── */

function pauseDialogVideos(scope: Element | null) {
  if (!scope) return;
  for (const video of scope.querySelectorAll('video')) {
    video.pause();
  }
}

function Root({
  onBeforeClose,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Root>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Root
      {...props}
      onBeforeClose={(ctx) => {
        pauseDialogVideos(
          ctx.destination?.closest('[data-ramka-content]') ?? ctx.destination,
        );
        onBeforeClose?.(ctx);
      }}
    />
  );
}

function Trigger({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Trigger>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Trigger className={cx('stl-trigger', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Portal({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Portal>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Portal className={cx('stl-portal', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Backdrop({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Backdrop>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Backdrop className={cx('stl-backdrop', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Content({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Content>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Content className={cx('stl-content', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Stage({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Stage>, 'children'> & {
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Stage className={cx('stl-stage', className)} {...props}>
      {({ morphRef }) => (
        <div ref={morphRef} className="stl-frame">
          {children}
        </div>
      )}
    </RamkaLightbox.Stage>
  );
}

function Close({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Close>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Close className={cx('stl-close', className)} aria-label="Close" {...props}>
      {children ?? <IconX />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Close>
  );
}

function Slides({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Slides>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Slides className={cx('stl-slides', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Slide({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Slide>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Slide className={cx('stl-slide', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Item({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Item>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Item className={cx('stl-item', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Media({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Media>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Media className={cx('stl-media', className)} {...props} />;
}

function Previous({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Previous>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Previous
      className={cx('stl-nav', 'stl-nav-prev', className)}
      aria-label="Previous"
      {...props}
    >
      {children ?? <IconChevronLeft />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Previous>
  );
}

function Next({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Next>) {
  return (
    <RamkaLightbox.Next
      className={cx('stl-nav', 'stl-nav-next', className)}
      aria-label="Next"
      {...props}
    >
      {children ?? <IconChevronRight />}
    </RamkaLightbox.Next>
  );
}

function Counter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RamkaLightbox.Counter>) {
  return <RamkaLightbox.Counter className={cx('stl-counter', className)} {...props} />;
}

/* ── Video (plays while this slide is active; pause in place when not) ─── */

function StoryVideo({
  src,
  poster,
  alt,
  width,
  height,
  active,
}: {
  src: string;
  poster: string;
  alt: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  active: boolean;
}) {
  const { open, dialogElementRef } = useLightboxContext();
  const videoRef = React.useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);

  const syncPlayback = React.useCallback(() => {
    const el = videoRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const content = dialogElementRef.current;
    const pulling =
      !!content &&
      (content.hasAttribute('data-pulling') || content.hasAttribute('data-pull-dismissing'));
    if (active && open && !pulling) {
      el.play().catch(() => {});
    } else {
      el.pause();
    }
  }, [active, open, dialogElementRef]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    syncPlayback();
  }, [syncPlayback]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const content = dialogElementRef.current;
    if (!content) return;
    const mo = new MutationObserver(syncPlayback);
    mo.observe(content, {
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['data-pulling', 'data-pull-dismissing'],
    });
    return () => mo.disconnect();
  }, [dialogElementRef, syncPlayback]);

  return (
    <video
      ref={videoRef}
      src={src}
      poster={poster}
      width={width}
      height={height}
      playsInline
      muted
      loop
      preload={active ? 'auto' : 'metadata'}
      aria-label={alt}
      className="stl-video"
    />
  );
}

/* ── Composed Gallery ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function StoryHud({ item, index, total }: { item: LightboxItem; index: number; total: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="stl-hud">
      <div className="stl-progress" aria-hidden>
        {Array.from({ length: total }, (_, j) => (
          <span
            key={j}
            className="stl-progress-seg"
            data-state={j === index ? 'current' : j < index ? 'past' : 'future'}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="stl-meta">
        <img src={item.avatar} alt="" className="stl-meta-avatar" draggable={false} />
        <div className="stl-meta-text">
          <span className="stl-meta-name">{item.name}</span>
          {item.time ? <span className="stl-meta-time">{item.time}</span> : null}
        </div>
        <Close />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Gallery({ items, ariaLabel }: { items: LightboxItem[]; ariaLabel: string }) {
  const multiple = items.length > 1;

  return (
    <Portal>
      <Backdrop />
      <Content aria-label={ariaLabel}>
        {multiple ? <Previous className="stl-chrome-gesture-hide" /> : null}
        <Stage>
          <Slides
            aria-label="Stories"
            // The library ships no copy, so the words announcing the carousel
            // and its slides live here, next to the rest of your UI strings.
            aria-roledescription="carousel"
            preload={1}
          >
            {items.map((item, i) => (
              <Slide key={item.id ?? i}>
                <Item
                  index={i}
                  aria-roledescription="slide"
                  aria-label={`${i + 1} of ${items.length}`}
                >
                  {({ active }) => (
                    <Media
                      width={item.width}
                      height={item.height}
                      className="stl-card"
                      style={{
                        backgroundImage: `url(${item.poster})`,
                        backgroundSize: 'cover',
                        backgroundPosition: 'center',
                      }}
                    >
                      <StoryVideo
                        src={item.video}
                        poster={item.poster}
                        alt={item.alt}
                        width={item.width}
                        height={item.height}
                        active={active}
                      />
                      <StoryHud item={item} index={i} total={items.length} />
                    </Media>
                  )}
                </Item>
              </Slide>
            ))}
          </Slides>
        </Stage>
        {multiple ? (
          <>
            <Next className="stl-chrome-gesture-hide" />
            <Counter className="stl-chrome-gesture-hide" />
          </>
        ) : null}
      </Content>
    </Portal>
  );
}

/**
 * Styled Lightbox namespace — drop-in replacement for `import * as Lightbox from '@ramka/react/lightbox'`
 * with this preset’s styles and composed Gallery.
 */
export const Lightbox = {
  Root,
  Trigger,
  Portal,
  Backdrop,
  Content,
  Stage,
  Close,
  Slides,
  Slide,
  Item,
  Media,
  Previous,
  Next,
  Counter,
  Gallery,
};
```

```css presets/stories/lightbox.css
/**
 * Stories lightbox skin — pairs with lightbox.tsx (copy both files).
 *
 * 9:16 story cards with a scroll-driven rotateY page-turn (CSS view-timeline).
 * Translucent themed scrim (no blur); chrome matches light/dark. Class prefix: `stl-`.
 *
 * Variables named `--lightbox-*` are written by the library at runtime
 * (gesture progress, motion timing) — this file only reads them. All
 * view-transition CSS (morph group, snapshots, crossfade) is injected by the
 * library; skins ship none of it.
 */

.stl-portal {
  --stl-ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --stl-blue: #007aff;
  /* Camera distance for the page-turn. ~1.8× a phone-width card so rotateY
     foreshortens instead of looking like a 2D squash. */
  --stl-perspective: 720px;
  --stl-scrim: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72);
  --stl-chrome-bg: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08);
  --stl-chrome-bg-hover: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14);
  --stl-chrome-fg: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.88);
  --stl-chrome-fg-muted: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55);
  --stl-frame-ring: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12);
  --stl-frame-radius: 1.75rem;
  --stl-card-radius: 8px;
  --stl-stage-bg: #fff;
}

:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark']) .stl-portal {
  --stl-blue: #0a84ff;
  --stl-scrim: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.64);
  --stl-chrome-bg: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08);
  --stl-chrome-bg-hover: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14);
  --stl-chrome-fg: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9);
  --stl-chrome-fg-muted: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72);
  --stl-frame-ring: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12);
  --stl-stage-bg: #000;
}

/* ── Trigger (circular avatar) ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

.stl-trigger {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: transparent;
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  appearance: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.stl-trigger:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.stl-trigger:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--stl-blue);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* ── Backdrop / Content open-close + pull ───────────────────────────────── */

.stl-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  background-color: var(--stl-scrim);
  transition: opacity var(--lightbox-pull-snap-duration, var(--lightbox-vt-duration, 360ms))
    var(--lightbox-pull-snap-easing, var(--stl-ease-out));
}

@starting-style {
  .stl-backdrop[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

.stl-backdrop[data-open] {
  opacity: calc(1 - var(--lightbox-pull-progress, 0) * 0.6);
}

.stl-backdrop[data-pulling] {
  transition: none;
}

.stl-content {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  outline: none;
  opacity: 0;
  color: #fafafa;
  transition: opacity var(--lightbox-vt-duration, 360ms) var(--stl-ease-out);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .stl-content {
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0 1rem;
  }
}

.stl-content[data-open] {
  opacity: 1;
}

@starting-style {
  .stl-content[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* ── 9:16 frame (Stage host sizes; inner frame is the morph target) ───── */

.stl-stage {
  align-self: stretch;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .stl-stage {
    align-self: center;
    width: auto;
    height: min(100% - 4rem, 52rem);
    aspect-ratio: 9 / 16;
    max-width: calc(100% - 8rem);
  }
}

.stl-frame {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  overflow: clip;
  background: transparent;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .stl-frame {
    border-radius: var(--stl-frame-radius);
  }
}

/* Shell chrome only after the open morph — not in the VT snapshot. */
.stl-content[data-open] .stl-frame {
  background: #000;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .stl-content[data-open] .stl-frame {
    background: var(--stl-stage-bg);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .stl-content[data-open] .stl-frame {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px var(--stl-frame-ring);
  }
}

/* ── Slides / 3D card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.stl-slides {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  gap: 0;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.stl-slides::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.stl-slide {
  flex: 0 0 100%;
  min-width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.stl-card {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  overflow: clip;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  border-radius: var(--stl-card-radius);
  transform-origin: center center;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

.stl-media {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.stl-video {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

/*
 * Scroll-driven page-turn. `perspective()` is on the same transform as
 * rotateY — not an ancestor `perspective` property — because Slides’
 * `overflow-x: auto` and Content’s `overflow: hidden` flatten nested 3D
 * contexts, which makes a lone rotateY look like a horizontal squash.
 */
@supports (view-timeline: --stl-stories inline) {
  .stl-slide {
    view-timeline: --stl-stories inline;
  }

  .stl-card {
    animation: stl-flip linear both;
    animation-timeline: --stl-stories;
    animation-range: cover;
  }
}

/*
 * Safari’s VT snapshot ignores backface-visibility and does not clip 3D
 * overflow the way live layout does. Neighbors parked at ±90deg (fill-mode
 * both after they leave `cover`) leak in as a flipped previous card —
 * especially when opening a non-first story, whose morph target sits next
 * to that edge-on slide. Flatten and hide them for the capture.
 */
:root[data-ramka-view-transition] .stl-card {
  animation: none !important;
  transform: none !important;
}

:root[data-ramka-view-transition] .stl-slide:not(:has([data-active])) {
  visibility: hidden;
}

@keyframes stl-flip {
  /* Stay on the front face: 90deg is edge-on and Safari will show the back. */
  0% {
    transform: perspective(var(--stl-perspective)) rotateY(89deg);
    transform-origin: left center;
  }
  49% {
    transform: perspective(var(--stl-perspective)) rotateY(0deg);
    transform-origin: left center;
  }
  50% {
    transform: perspective(var(--stl-perspective)) rotateY(0deg);
    transform-origin: center center;
  }
  51% {
    transform: perspective(var(--stl-perspective)) rotateY(0deg);
    transform-origin: right center;
  }
  100% {
    transform: perspective(var(--stl-perspective)) rotateY(-89deg);
    transform-origin: right center;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .stl-card {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ── HUD on the card (progress + identity + close) ──────────────────────── */

.stl-hud {
  pointer-events: none;
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: calc(0.625rem + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)) 0.75rem 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45) 0%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0) 7.5rem);
  transition: opacity var(--lightbox-pull-snap-duration, 200ms)
    var(--lightbox-pull-snap-easing, var(--stl-ease-out));
}

.stl-progress {
  display: flex;
  gap: 3px;
}

.stl-progress-seg {
  flex: 1;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35);
}

.stl-progress-seg[data-state='past'],
.stl-progress-seg[data-state='current'] {
  background: #fff;
}

.stl-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: 0.625rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.stl-meta-avatar {
  width: 1.75rem;
  height: 1.75rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  object-fit: cover;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2);
}

.stl-meta-text {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.375rem;
}

.stl-meta-name {
  overflow: hidden;

/* ── Counter (desktop only — mobile uses the HUD segments) ─────────────── */
```
